ticket: What happens to our data if we don't renew?
agent_response: If your subscription lapses without renewal, your account enters a 30-day grace period where data is retained but access is restricted to read-only. After 30 days, the account and all associated data are permanently deleted. We recommend exporting your data before the grace period ends if you're not planning to renew.
policy_context: Non-renewal policy: 30-day grace period after lapse. During grace: read-only access, data retained. After 30 days: account and data permanently deleted.
